name: Steward
ability: You start knowing 1 good player.
firstNightReminder: Point to the player marked 'Know'.

name: Knight
ability: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.
firstNightReminder: Point to the 2 players marked 'Know'.

name: Noble
ability: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.
firstNightReminder: Point to the 3 players marked 'Know'.

name: Shugenja
ability: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.
firstNightReminder: Point clockwise or anticlockwise.

name: Pixie
ability: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.
firstNightReminder: Show the Townsfolk character token marked 'Mad'.

name: Bounty Hunter
ability: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]
firstNightReminder: Point to the player marked 'Know'.
otherNightReminder: If the player marked 'Know' died today or tonight, point to the new player marked 'Know'.

name: High Priestess
ability: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.
firstNightReminder: Point to a player.

name: Balloonist
ability: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
firstNightReminder: Point to any player.
otherNightReminder: Point to a player with a different character type to the previously shown player.

name: General
ability: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.
firstNightReminder: Give a thumb signal.

name: Preacher
ability: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.
firstNightReminder: The Preacher chooses a player. If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the 'This character selected you' & Preacher tokens.
otherNightReminder: The Preacher chooses a player. If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the 'This character selected you' & Preacher tokens.

name: Village Idiot
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]
firstNightReminder: If there are multiple Village Idiots, mark one as 'Drunk'. Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.
otherNightReminder: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.

name: King
ability: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon: Show the 'This player is' & King tokens, then point to the King.
otherNightReminder: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, show the character token of a living player.

name: Cult Leader
ability: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.
firstNightReminder: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the 'You are' info token & give a thumb signal.
otherNightReminder: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the 'You are' info token & give a thumb signal.

name: Acrobat
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.

name: Lycanthrope
ability: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn't kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.

name: Alsaahir
ability: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and which are Demon(s), good wins.

name: Engineer
ability: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.
firstNightReminder: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the 'You are' info token & their new character token.
otherNightReminder: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the 'You are' info token & their new character token.

name: Nightwatchman
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the Nightwatchman.
firstNightReminder: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the 'This player is' & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman.
otherNightReminder: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the 'This player is' & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman.

name: Huntsman
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]
firstNightReminder: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the 'You are' info token & their new character token.
otherNightReminder: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the 'You are' info token & their new character token.

name: Fisherman
ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.

name: Princess
ability: On your 1st day, if you nominated & executed a player, the Demon doesn't kill tonight.
otherNightReminder: If the Princess nominated the player who was executed today, wake the Demon as normal, but no one dies to the Demon's ability.

name: Alchemist
ability: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
firstNightReminder: Show the 'You are' info token and a Minion token.

name: Cannibal
ability: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.

name: Amnesiac
ability: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.
firstNightReminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
otherNightReminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.

name: Farmer
ability: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.
otherNightReminder: If the Farmer died tonight, wake a living good player. Show the 'You are' info token and a Farmer token.

name: Choirboy
ability: If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. [+the King]
otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the King, point to the Demon player.

name: Banshee
ability: If the Demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.
otherNightReminder: If the Banshee was killed by the Demon tonight, announce that the Banshee has died.

name: Magician
ability: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.
firstNightReminder: During Minion Info, point to the Magician and the Demon. During Demon Info, point to the Magician and the Minions.

name: Poppy Grower
ability: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
firstNightReminder: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info. Wake the Demon. Show the 'These characters are not in play' token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
otherNightReminder: If the Poppy Grower died today or tonight, wake all Minions. Show the 'This is the Demon' token. Point to the Demon. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the 'These are your Minions' token. Point to the Minions.

name: Atheist
ability: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]
